authorityBoundary: Read-only taxonomy. A 6th verb requires >=2 real path:line witnesses AND explicit owner promotion. The validator refuses self-mint of verbs exactly as the proof-gate refuses self-mint of formula cards.

verbs.definition: Swap a hand-tuned magic constant for a principled or learnable curve (decay halfLife, drift weight, surprise K). The edit lands on the live conscience, so it ripples wide.
verbs.guardRequirement: A regression canary plus frozen guard weights MUST propagate with the pattern; never re-tune a constant without re-pinning the canary.

verbs.definition: Read the sample-count-aware lower bound, not the point estimate, at the ASSERT/HEDGE boundary. Belief width widens with low fresh-count so a thin sample HEDGEs instead of over-asserting.
verbs.guardRequirement: The RANK_RESEARCH / EXPLORE exemption MUST propagate or hypothesis-stage work gets vetoed; the de-duped distinct fresh-count is a single shared point of failure and must stay distinct-count, not raw count.

verbs.definition: Gate on per-source identity and dependence, not a conserved aggregate or raw count. One calibrated-per-lane verdict schema unlocks the whole family; correlated lanes must not read as independent witnesses.
verbs.guardRequirement: The correlation / shared-base-model tag MUST be a mandatory field, otherwise the family treats correlated lanes as independent witnesses and double-counts agreement.

verbs.definition: Build one shared resolved-outcome log (or shared prior store) once, and a whole family of downstream cards unblocks at once. Additive to build, but high-risk if shipped on a biased log.
verbs.guardRequirement: Each sibling that reads the shared log MUST inherit its drift correction; a biased outcome log silently poisons every consumer.

verbs.definition: Compose read-only analyzers over a static structure (architecture graph, formula-bank directory). Pure functions over a frozen artifact: safe to cascade because nothing is mutated.
verbs.guardRequirement: Any structural-VETO analyzer MUST whitelist intentional hub-and-spoke chokes before it gates merges; read-only stays read-only and never promotes itself to a mutator.
